name: What should I do immediately after water damage occurs?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after water damage occurs?

acceptedAnswer.text: First, ensure safety by turning off the main water supply and electricity to the affected areas if it's safe to do so. Then, contact a professional water damage restoration company immediately. While waiting for help, remove valuables, furniture, and electronics from the wet areas if possible. Avoid using a regular vacuum to remove water, as it can cause electric shock. Document the damage with photos or videos for insurance purposes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize safety by turning off water and electricity. Then, call a restoration company, move valuables, avoid electrical hazards, and document the damage.
